title: Pairing-free multi-omic graph attention network for GSE45498 TNBC tissue state: final study code, frozen edge lists and results
description: Code, frozen configuration (git tags tcga-edges-frozen-v1 and study-frozen-v1), frozen TCGA-derived edge list, all out-of-fold predictions, tables and figures of the final study. Raw GEO GSE45498 files as deposited by Cascione et al. are included; miRDB v6.0, TCGA (UCSC Xena), ABSOLUTE purity, ESTIMATE scores, miRBase, HGNC and miRTarBase 9.0 must be downloaded from their sources (sha256 in study/frozen/tcga_edges_info.json).
notes: Prepared, not published. Check creators, license and description before any deposit.
